title: a new creation

verses.text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.

caption:
You are not who you were, and God is not finished making things new.

A new creation is not a tidier version of the old one. It is a heart of flesh where stone used to be, and a way opening in ground that looked like wilderness. If today feels like the same old dust, look again.

2 Corinthians 5:17, Ezekiel 36:26, Isaiah 43:19 (BSB)
